response.path_title: Building Production-Ready REST APIs with FastAPI
response.path_description: For developers who know Python: design, build, secure and test an HTTP API with FastAPI, Pydantic and a real database.

milestones.title: HTTP and REST Design
milestones.description: Methods, status codes, resources, idempotency and how to design clean endpoint URLs.

milestones.title: FastAPI Basics
milestones.description: Path and query parameters, request bodies and automatic OpenAPI docs for your first endpoint.

milestones.title: Validation with Pydantic
milestones.description: Models, field constraints, nested schemas and turning validation errors into useful 422 responses.

milestones.title: Database Integration
milestones.description: SQLAlchemy models, sessions as dependencies, migrations with Alembic, and avoiding N+1 queries.

milestones.title: Authentication and Authorization
milestones.description: Password hashing, OAuth2 password flow, JWT tokens and per-route permission checks.

milestones.title: Testing and Error Handling
milestones.description: pytest with TestClient, fixtures for a test database, and consistent error responses.

milestones.title: Deployment
milestones.description: Containerise with Docker, run behind Uvicorn/Gunicorn, configure via environment variables and add health checks.
